files.title: Hierarchical checkboxes
files.body: Checking a folder checks what is under it, partly checked folders show it, and children load lazily from a source that also works from disk.

files.title: Wide tree
files.body: A document library with more columns than a laptop holds: the tree and owner pin left, the status pins right, the description takes the spare width and the least important columns hide first.

files.title: Org chart and deep folders
files.body: An organisation chart with many columns, a file system with deep folders, and nested groups that start collapsed, with the tree toolbar, column fitting and auto height.

files.title: Tree inside a grid
files.body: A regional inventory whose detail rows are trees of their own, with their own labels and time zone.

files.title: Pipeline board
files.body: Pipelines as group rows above their latest runs, beside the flat runs grid and its filter builder on the same page.

files.title: Plugins on a tree
files.body: A page plugin adds a cell renderer, a toolbar button, a menu entry and event hooks; the same plugin serves a grid.

files.title: Custom export formats
files.body: The page registers its own export writers; the tree runs them on its visible, selected or all rows.

inventory.title: Grouping and aggregates
inventory.body: Orders grouped by region and status with sum, average, count and distinct-count in the headings and totals; each order expands into a nested grid of its lines.

inventory.title: Editing
inventory.body: Every editor type, validation from C# and from the page, read-only rows, undo and redo, and a batch save that the service answers per row.

inventory.title: Conditional formatting
inventory.body: Row highlights, tones, a data bar on CPU, a colour scale on latency, threshold bands and a stale cue, with the legend and the rule editor.

inventory.title: Facet panel
inventory.body: Category, priority, team and region facets with counts, and histograms for dates and age; the facets filter each other and the grid.

inventory.title: Column groups and cell ranges
inventory.body: Months under quarters under half years, the budget line pinned left, cell ranges with copy, paste and the fill handle.

inventory.title: Record panel
inventory.body: Eight columns per row and about sixty fields per record in tabs and sections, with related records, a timeline of changes and deep links.

inventory.title: Live data
inventory.body: Rows change in place from a stream with flashing cells and an order-changed prompt, and a job queue the grid polls with revision-aware refresh.

inventory.title: Linked views
inventory.body: A site picker filters a grid and a hosted grid and highlights a tree; the grid's selection marks the picker.

inventory.title: Search highlighting and layouts
inventory.body: Matches marked in place with a count and next and previous, and the Layout menu with fit, scroll and card layouts in three densities.

inventory.title: Export formats
inventory.body: The page's own writers join the Export menu after CSV, with the scope picker, progress and cancellation.

inventory.title: Status board
inventory.body: Enum pills in every tone, plain values beside them, and link rows a host can route itself.

inventory.title: Typed C# grid
inventory.body: Columns from member expressions, so renaming a member changes the grid or fails the build, and rows straight from the records.

inventory.title: French labels
inventory.body: The French label pack on a reporting grid; Polish, German, Spanish and Italian packs are included too.

calendar.title: Basic calendar
calendar.body: A list of events and nothing else: month, week, day and agenda, read-only, with a details popover.

calendar.title: Scheduler
calendar.body: Creating events, dropping work from a grid, sources with a legend, office hours shaded and context menus.

calendar.title: Layouts
calendar.body: A mini month, week and day lists, stacked months and a year with its events.

calendar.title: 3,000 certificate expiries
calendar.body: A facet panel beside the calendar, busy days folded into +N more, and a timeline per issuer at month zoom.

calendar.title: Password expiries
calendar.body: A directory's password expiries as an all-day agenda per person, grouped by department in the timeline.

calendar.title: Calendar and grid, linked
calendar.body: Selecting days filters the grid, and selecting rows highlights their events in the calendar.

timeline.title: Engineers' day
timeline.body: A day view with one column per engineer and each engineer's own working hours.

timeline.title: Timeline without resources
timeline.body: A release timeline whose events pack into rows by overlap over a custom span.

matrix.title: Replication between 150 servers
matrix.body: A square matrix of inbound replication between domain controllers, grouped by site.

matrix.title: 400 policies by 40 servers
matrix.body: Opens on the problems only, so the few differences stand out in a large matrix.

changes.title: A 20,000-line diff
changes.body: One large file's diff with windowed rows, folded regions and word marks, still quick to scroll.

flow.title: Stepper with choice cards
flow.body: A four-step flow with choice cards, a password that never echoes, options that appear only when they apply, and a review page.

flow.title: Vertical stepper
flow.body: Report cards, grouped multiple choice, weekdays that appear only for a weekly schedule, durations and recipients.

flow.title: Edit existing settings
flow.body: Starts from the current values; the review shows only what changed as was and now, and the proposal carries a JSON patch.

flow.title: Server checks and drafts
flow.body: Connection and sign-in tests, host-listed options, records, presets, a session draft, deep links and the equivalent command.

flow.title: Act on selected rows
flow.body: Opens in a dialog, picks servers from a grid with facets, and asks the reader to type RETIRE before the host acts.

flow.title: Dialog-sized task
flow.body: One step, no review page, compact density; also written in Polish and right to left.

email.title: Formatted table
email.body: The conditional formatting rules of the server grid, as a script-free table.

email.title: Matrix for email
email.body: A services matrix with tone cells and grouped servers, then the same data as a list.

email.title: Table with totals
email.body: Page totals and all-matching totals in footer rows, without script.

email.title: Change list for email
email.body: The change list and its flags as a table a mail client keeps.
